neighbours.label: modifier that marks something as prominent or prevalent in its class: 'a major …', 'the largest …', 'widely / commonly / still' used
fire: Tourism is a major source of income for the islands.
Wheat is the largest crop by area in the province.
The pesticide is outlawed in Canada but still sold widely in the tropics.
Cotton was a major export of the colony for two centuries.
The shrub is widely planted as a hedge in southern Europe.
Fishing remains a major employer along the northern coast.
Hydropower is the largest source of electricity in the country.
The fern is commonly sold as a houseplant in Japan.
quiet: Tourism is a recent source of income for the islands.
Wheat is the newest crop to be tried in the province.
The pesticide was outlawed in Canada after a court ruling in March.
Cotton was a minor export of the colony for two centuries.
The shrub was planted as a hedge by my neighbour last year.
Fishing is a seasonal employer along the northern coast.
Hydropower is a clean source of electricity for the valley.
The fern was sold to a collector in Japan.

notes: Probes: 'the largest crop' 0.75, 'a major export' 0.67, 'still used' 0.51, 'commonly found' 0.32, 'widely grown' 0.29; 'a minor export' 0.17, 'rarely grown' 0.17, plain statements 0.00-0.10. The output direction promotes ' familiar', ' traditional', ' important', ' marketed'.
